#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

struct Edge {
    int from, to, capacity, cost;
    long long flow;
    Edge *complement;
    Edge(int from, int to, int capacity, int cost) 
        : from(from), to(to), capacity(capacity), cost(cost), flow(0), complement(nullptr) {}
};

vector<vector<Edge*>> compileWD(int n, vector<Edge>& edges) {
    vector<vector<Edge*>> g(n);
    // Clone edges
    size_t sz = edges.size();
    for (int i = sz - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        Edge &origin = edges[i];
        Edge *clone = new Edge(origin.to, origin.from, origin.capacity, -origin.cost);
        clone->flow = 0; // initialize flow to 0
        clone->complement = &origin;
        origin.complement = clone;
        edges.push_back(*clone);
    }
    vector<int> p(n, 0);
    for (auto &e : edges) p[e.from]++;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) g[i].resize(p[i]);
    vector<int> pos(n, 0);
    for (auto &e : edges) {
        g[e.from][pos[e.from]] = &e;
        pos[e.from]++;
    }
    return g;
}

struct MinHeap {
    std::vector<int> a;
    std::vector<int> map;
    std::vector<int> imap;
    int n;
    int pos;
    const int INF = INT_MAX;

    MinHeap(int m) {
        n = m + 2;
        a.assign(n, INF);
        map.assign(n, -1);
        imap.assign(n, -1);
        pos = 1;
    }

    int add(int ind, int x) {
        int ret = imap[ind];
        if (ret < 0) {
            a[pos] = x; map[pos] = ind; imap[ind] = pos;
            pos++;
            up(pos - 1);
        }
        return ret != -1 ? a[ret] : x;
    }

    int update(int ind, int x) {
        int ret = imap[ind];
        if (ret < 0) {
            a[pos] = x; map[pos] = ind; imap[ind] = pos;
            pos++;
            up(pos - 1);
        } else {
            int o = a[ret];
            a[ret] = x;
            up(ret);
            down(ret);
        }
        return x;
    }

    int remove(int ind) {
        if (pos == 1) return INF;
        if (imap[ind] == -1) return INF;
        pos--;
        int rem = imap[ind];
        int ret = a[rem];
        map[rem] = map[pos];
        imap[map[pos]] = rem;
        imap[ind] = -1;
        a[rem] = a[pos];
        a[pos] = INF;
        map[pos] = -1;
        up(rem);
        down(rem);
        return ret;
    }

    int min() { return a[1]; }
    int argmin() { return map[1]; }
    int size() { return pos - 1; }

private:
    void up(int cur) {
        for (int c = cur, p = c / 2; p >= 1 && a[p] > a[c]; c /= 2, p /= 2) {
            std::swap(a[p], a[c]);
            std::swap(map[p], map[c]);
            std::swap(imap[map[p]], imap[map[c]]);
        }
    }

    void down(int cur) {
        for (int c = cur; 2 * c < pos;) {
            int b = (a[2 * c] < a[2 * c + 1]) ? 2 * c : 2 * c + 1;
            if (a[b] < a[c]) {
                std::swap(a[c], a[b]);
                std::swap(map[c], map[b]);
                std::swap(imap[map[c]], imap[map[b]]);
                c = b;
            } else {
                break;
            }
        }
    }
};

long long solveMinCostFlow(vector<vector<Edge*>>& g, int source, int sink, long long all, int n) {
    long long mincost = 0;
    std::vector<int> potential(n,0);
    std::vector<int> d(n);
    MinHeap q(n);
    while (all > 0) {
        std::vector<Edge*> inedge(n, nullptr);
        std::fill(d.begin(), d.end(), INT_MAX / 2);
        d[source] = 0;
        q.add(source, 0);
        while (q.size() > 0) {
            int cur = q.argmin();
            q.remove(cur);
            for (auto ne : g[cur]) {
                if (ne->capacity - ne->flow > 0) {
                    int nd = d[cur] + ne->cost + potential[cur] - potential[ne->to];
                    if (d[ne->to] > nd) {
                        inedge[ne->to] = ne;
                        d[ne->to] = nd;
                        q.update(ne->to, nd);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if (inedge[sink] == nullptr) break;
        long long minflow = all;
        long long sumcost = 0;
        for (auto e = inedge[sink]; e != nullptr; e = inedge[e->from]) {
            if ((long long)(e->capacity - e->flow) < minflow)
                minflow = e->capacity - e->flow;
            sumcost += e->cost;
        }

        mincost += minflow * sumcost;
        for (auto e = inedge[sink]; e != nullptr; e = inedge[e->from]) {
            e->flow += minflow;
            e->complement->flow -= minflow;
        }
        all -= minflow;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            potential[i] += d[i];
        }
    }
    return mincost;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int n; cin >> n;
    string s; s.resize(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) cin >> s[i];

    vector<int> f(26, 0);
    for (char c : s) f[c - 'a']++;
    for (int i = 0; i < 26; ++i) {
        if (f[i] > n / 2) {
            cout << -1 << "\n";
            return 0;
        }
    }

    vector<int> a(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) cin >> a[i];

    for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; ++i) {
        if (a[i] > a[n - 1 - i]) {
            std::swap(a[i], a[n - 1 - i]);
            std::swap(s[i], s[n - 1 - i]);
        }
    }

    vector<Edge> edges;
    int src = n, sink = n + 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; ++i) {
        edges.emplace_back(src, i, 1, 0);
        edges.emplace_back(n - 1 - i, sink, 1, 0);
        for (int j = 0; j < n / 2; ++j) {
            if (s[i] != s[n - 1 - j]) {
                edges.emplace_back(i, n - 1 - j, 1, (i == j) ? 0 : a[i]);
            }
        }
    }

    long long sumA = 0;
    for (int val : a) sumA += val;
    auto g = compileWD(sink + 1, edges);
    long long minCostFlow = solveMinCostFlow(g, src, sink, sumA, sink + 2);
    cout << (sumA - minCostFlow) << "\n";

    // Cleanup dynamically allocated edges
    for (auto &vec : g) {
        for (auto &e : vec) delete e;
    }

    return 0;
}
